record.question: World Environment Day was first observed on
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: UNEP records the first World Environment Day in 1973, held on 5 June. The 1972 Stockholm conference preceded it, but the first observance was the following year; the question asks for the first date, not the conference year.
